title: MWS — Reproductive/Hormonal
description: Pregnancy and breastfeeding history, oral contraceptive use, menopausal hormone treatment (HRT), and menstrual history recorded at recruitment. Merges what were originally four smaller groupings (pregnancy, contraceptive, HRT, menstrual) into the CD3 target schema's own Reproductive/Hormonal domain.

RNUMFTP.title: Number of full-term pregnancies
RNUMFTP.$comment: Source's own code list only labels the top code (10=10 or more); 0-9 are plain unlabeled counts, not enumerated codes. 10 is a real top-coded substantive value, not a missingness sentinel -- D025.

RBFYN.title: Ever breastfed
RBFYN.$comment: Source's own code list includes -1=Not on questionnaire for this field (Blue version = No availability). missing_numeric added alongside per D020.

RBFNUM.title: Number of children breastfed
RBFNUM.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-20 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024. Source's code list documents -1=Unable to derive (not asked on questionnaire) (Blue version = No availability), mapped to the shared not_on_questionnaire sentinel; missing_numeric added alongside per D020.

RBFDUR.title: Total breastfeeding duration
RBFDUR.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-240 months (20 years) is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024. Source's code list documents -1=Unable to derive (not asked on questionnaire) (Blue version = No availability); missing_numeric added alongside per D020.

ROCSTART.title: Age started oral contraceptives
ROCSTART.$comment: Source states no valid range; 10-60 is an agent-decided plausibility bound -- D024.

ROCSTOP.title: Age stopped oral contraceptives
ROCSTOP.$comment: Source states no valid range; 10-60 is an agent-decided plausibility bound -- D024.

ROCDUR.title: Total duration of oral contraceptive use
ROCDUR.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-50 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024.

RHRTSTA.title: Age started HRT
RHRTSTA.$comment: Source states a valid range of From=25 only (To is blank/unstated). Minimum 25 is source-stated; maximum 90 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024.

RHTDUR.title: Total duration of HRT use
RHTDUR.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-50 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024.

RHRTSTO.title: Age last used HRT
RHRTSTO.$comment: Source states no valid range; 25-90 is an agent-decided plausibility bound, matching RHRTSTA's floor -- D024.

RHTLU.title: Time since HRT last used
RHTLU.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-50 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024.

RPSTOPAG.title: Age periods stopped
RPSTOPAG.$comment: Source states no valid range; 20-70 is an agent-decided plausibility bound -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RPSTOPYN -- D028 (inferred routing, pending steward confirmation).

$comment: Soft checks (not enforceable in JSON Schema -- cross-field numeric comparisons): RAGELB should be >= RAGEFB when both are substantive; ROCSTOP should be >= ROCSTART; RHRTSTO should be >= RHRTSTA. (RPSTOPAG's routing against RPSTOPYN is enforced as a real mother-file skip pair, not listed here -- D028.)
